definitions.short: Jegar-Sahadutha , a cairn East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H3026. Yegar Sahadutha [ יְגַּר ] noun [masculine] (stone-)heap ( ᵑ7 id. ; Syriac ; compare Ethiopic throw together , mound ); — construct ׳י שָֽׂהֲדוּתָא Gen 31:47 (= Hebrew גַּלעֵֿד ).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to 7717 ; heap of the testimony;
